assignment: Real Google SERP captures for 10 of Mitch's target keywords (2 per intent) for the 'search results by intent' post expansion, 2026-09-22.
researcher_note: ALL 10 CAPTURES FAILED. Every attempt — headless Chrome (puppeteer-core, local machine) and the in-app browser (separate network path) — was blocked by Google before any SERP content rendered. No AI Overview / ads / local pack / featured snippet / PAA / shopping / video / organic-result / mitchjmiller.com presence could be observed for any query. Do not treat any 'not observable' field below as a negative result (i.e. 'feature absent') — it means the page was never seen. See root_cause for why, and serp-examples/notes.md for full methodology and what to do next.

capture_method.headless: puppeteer-core driving local Google Chrome via the repo's existing content-studio/viz/kit/export/lib/browser.mjs helper (no new dependency). Script: capture-serp.mjs in this folder. hl=en&gl=us&num=10 on every query. Desktop viewport 1280x1000 @1x; mobile viewport 390x844 @2x with a Pixel 8 Android Chrome UA. Full-page PNG screenshot taken ~1.8s after networkidle2.
capture_method.in_app_browser_fallback: mcp__Claude_Browser__* tools (navigate, resize_window, computer:screenshot) per the assignment's instruction to document a consent/captcha/unusual-traffic page rather than bypass it. Never clicked the reCAPTCHA checkbox.

root_cause.finding: This session's outbound internet connection — both the local Mac used for the headless-Chrome run and the separate network path behind the in-app Browser pane — resolves to a residential ISP in Metro Manila, Philippines (AS10139 Smart Broadband, Inc.), not a US IP. Google's abuse system serves a 429 'unusual traffic' reCAPTCHA interstitial to this network for Google Search regardless of the &hl=en&gl=us query parameters, which only set language/region *preferences* and do not override IP-based geolocation or bot-risk scoring.
evidence: Headless Chrome egress: 2407:9803:5340:3423:c4ab:73cc:1d0c:f59f -> ip-api.com: Manila, PH, AS10139 Smart Broadband, Inc.
In-app browser egress: 175.158.207.7 -> ip-api.com: Quezon City, PH, AS10139 Smart Broadband, Inc.
Same ASN/ISP on both paths; both blocked identically.
root_cause.consistency_with_prior_ledger: Matches content-studio/research/2026-09-14/search-intent/notes.md, which independently found 'Google: fully blocked on every attempt' and Bing results geolocating to the Philippines (.ph domains, PHP pricing) despite &mkt=en-US&cc=US. This is now confirmed with IP/ASN evidence rather than inferred from symptoms.
root_cause.recommendation: A real US-IP browsing session (Mitch's own residential/office connection, or a US-based proxy/VPN he approves) is required to capture live Google SERPs for this environment. This falls outside what either automation path available in this session can do without solving a CAPTCHA, which is off-limits.
